basic_info.description: Charming Corner Multi-Generational Home in Parkside District.  As you step into this beautifully maintained home, you will be captivated by its charm and attention to detail.    The main level includes two well-appointed bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a spacious kitchen with a dining area perfect for casual meals. The generous living room, complete with a gas fireplace, adds warmth and character. Additionally, the formal dining room offers an excellent space for hosting guests. On the upper level, you'll find a spacious master suite that includes a half bathroom, providing added privacy. The lower unit, which has a private entrance, features a large family room, two bedrooms, an additional bathroom, and a kitchen nook area, making it a perfect arrangement for guests or extended family. The over-sized garage provides ample storage space, while the landscaped backyard features a lovely deck, ideal for hosting gatherings or enjoying a morning beverage in a tranquil setting.     This home is conveniently located near some of the area's most popular attractions, including Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco Zoo, West Portal,etc, easy access to public transportation,local restaurants, and schools!
